message.content:
## Cause
`customer.name` is `null` when `OrderService.place` calls `length()` on it (OrderService.java:42).

## Fix
Validate the request (`@NotBlank name`) or guard the call:
```java
if (customer.getName() == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("name required");
```

*(Stub reply from the Logboard demo LLM.)*
